summary: rwc-client preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscated (_0xNNNN identifiers, musl detection, header spoofing as 'node', platform selector) and, at preinstall time, resolves a platform-specific Bun tarball URL of the form https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip, downloads it to a temp directory, extracts it via unzip / PowerShell Expand-Archive / an inline ZIP parser, chmods the binary 0755, and then invokes the freshly-downloaded Bun binary via execFileSync to run a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte Bun-only artifact ('// @bun @bun-cjs' header) that is heavily obfuscated with string-array rotation (WV8StW), a large mixed literal array (n7gIxM), and a custom base-N string decoder (hc1jfK9) keyed by a scrambled alphabet, so its behavior is not statically resolvable without executing the decoder. The delivered runtime is Bun rather than Node, so Node-based install-time scanners on the installer's machine never observe the payload's execution. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: fetching a second language runtime and using it to execute an opaque bundled script on the installer's machine at npm install time, with the wrapper itself obfuscated to cloak intent.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
